retail_screen.evidence: The Lowe's product page says this item is no longer sold on Lowes.com. This is not a claim about every distributor.

bolted_detail_screen.manufacturer_table_bolts: four 3/8-inch bolts for B66; ASTM A307 or better
bolted_detail_screen.manufacturer_table_pairing_note: Corner braces are required on both sides for F1 load in both directions.
bolted_detail_screen.disposition: MiTek's published bolted load table is inapplicable to the preserved single-2x6 receiver. Do not transfer its F1/F2 numbers to this frame.

home_depot_sibling_ub88_screen.catalog_bolts: six 3/8-inch bolts; ASTM A307 or better
home_depot_sibling_ub88_screen.disposition: Home Depot lists the factory product and MiTek publishes B88 bolt-mode loads, but the same table requires 3-inch-minimum wood members. The 1.5-inch 2x6 cannot inherit those loads; a larger bracket does not solve the preserved-stock mismatch.

search_boundary: Targeted Lowe's/Home Depot follow-up after the original three-family screen; no market-exhaustion claim.
